provenance: measured (deterministic local guard execution against primary upstream PRs/Issues)

scenarios.title_zh: x402 `@x402/fetch` 客户端单次调用上限/报价单锚定（拦截 10 倍恶意溢价）与 Payfetch 请求头归一
scenarios.title_en: x402 @x402/fetch Per-Call MaxAmount/Quote Cap (Blocking 10x Overcharge) & Payfetch Header Parity
scenarios.question_zh: 恶意资源服务器在 402 挑战中声明 10 倍于预期价格的金额，且客户端未绑定单次调用上限
scenarios.question_en: Adversarial server declares 10x inflated amount in 402 challenge against @x402/fetch client
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 默认 `@x402/fetch` 无条件签名并提交服务端在 402 中声明的任意金额，导致 10 倍超额扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Default @x402/fetch unconditionally signs and submits any amount declared by the 402 server

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Go 资源服务器 `eip155:*` 通配符网络解析、XRPL 离线多签法定人数校验与 t54 `InvoiceID` 绑定
scenarios.title_en: x402 Go Wildcard Network Resolution, XRPL Offline Multisig Quorum & t54 InvoiceID Binding
scenarios.question_zh: XRPL 多签交易权重之和未达 `SignerQuorum`（或顶层 `SigningPubKey` 非空），或通配符网络未命中
scenarios.question_en: XRPL multisig transaction weight sum falls short of SignerQuorum or wildcard network fails to resolve
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: XRPL `/verify` 缺乏多签 `SignerList`/`SignerQuorum` 离线校验规范，且 Go 无法匹配 `eip155:*`
scenarios.classic_fail_en: XRPL /verify lacks offline SignerList/quorum verification and Go server misses eip155:* wildcard

scenarios.title_zh: x402 参数化路由与 Java Servlet 路径规范化绕过防护及 SIWX 服务端权威 URL 权益绑定
scenarios.title_en: x402 Parameterised Route & Java Servlet Paywall Bypass Guard + SIWX Server-Canonical Entitlement URL
scenarios.question_zh: 客户端在 `PaymentPayload.resource.url` 注入高权限路径，企图在 SIWX 结算钩子中伪造跨路由访问权益
scenarios.question_en: Client spoofs PaymentPayload.resource.url to record SIWX entitlement on an unpurchased route
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `createSIWxSettleHook` 直接信任客户端提交的 `paymentPayload.resource.url` 写入权益表
scenarios.classic_fail_en: createSIWxSettleHook records entitlement under client-supplied paymentPayload.resource.url

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Fail-Closed `settledResponse` 重试恢复扩展、Fastify `preHandler` 钩子时序与 Stellar 合约账户动态费率上限
scenarios.title_en: x402 Fail-Closed settledResponse Recovery, Fastify preHandler Ordering & Stellar Smart-Account Fee Ceiling
scenarios.question_zh: Stellar 智能合约账户 `__check_auth` 跨合约鉴权需 180,000 stroops，被 Facilitator 静态 50,000 stroops 上限误拒
scenarios.question_en: Stellar smart-account __check_auth cross-contract call requires 180k stroops but static 50k limit rejects it
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 静态 50,000 stroops 上限拒绝所有跨合约鉴权的 Stellar 智能账户，且 Fastify 在解析请求体前执行支付钩子
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Static 50k-stroop fee cap breaks Stellar smart-account payers and Fastify runs hooks before body parse

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 邮政地址结构化行组件、标准化履约事件类型与嵌套捆绑商品（Nested Bundle `parent_id`）原子性护栏
scenarios.title_en: UCP Postal Address Line Components, Standardized Fulfillment Events & Nested Bundle Semantics Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 买家或 Agent 试图单独取消/退订原子捆绑包（Atomic Bundle `parent_id`）中的高单价子组件以套取捆绑折扣
scenarios.question_en: Caller attempts partial cancellation of a child component inside an atomic bundle line item
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 未定义 `parent_id` 捆绑语义，允许拆分退掉捆绑包原价子件并保留特价赠品
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Lack of parent_id bundle semantics permits partial component cancellation that exploits bundle pricing

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 相似商品替代库存核验、餐饮菜品逐过敏原状态（阻断 `unknown`/`may_contain`）与 RFC 9421 ECDSA Raw `r||s` 编码
scenarios.title_en: UCP Catalog Similarity, Food Per-Allergen Safety Gate & RFC 9421 §3.3.4/§3.3.5 ECDSA Raw r||s Rule
scenarios.question_zh: 买家设置花生过敏限制，但餐品花生过敏原状态为 `unknown`（或 `may_contain`）时仍被加入结账
scenarios.question_en: Dish with 'unknown' or 'may_contain' peanut status is ordered for a buyer with a peanut allergy restriction
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 将未标注（`unknown`）过敏原的菜品默认当作安全（`free_from`）推荐给过敏买家，或混用 ASN.1 DER 签名
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Treats 'unknown' allergen status as safe for restricted buyers and mixes ASN.1 DER with raw r||s

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 隐私边界广告归因维度、根级数组 JSON Schema 反模式阻断与零手续费 Nano（XNO）支付工具校验
scenarios.title_en: UCP Privacy-Safe Ad Attribution, Root-Array Schema Anti-Pattern Guard & Nano (XNO) Payment Instrument
scenarios.question_zh: 扩展 Schema 使用顶层 `type: array` 破坏向后兼容演进，或广告归因夹带明文买家 PII
scenarios.question_en: Extension schema uses root-level type: array anti-pattern blocking additive evolution
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 顶层数组 Schema 无法在不破坏兼容性的前提下新增元数据字段，且缺乏无手续费即时终局 XNO 格式校验
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Root-array schemas prevent non-breaking metadata additions and lack Nano (XNO) format validation

scenarios.title_zh: UCP Payment Terms `/complete` 空 `payment: {}` 拦截、首次接触加速 IdP 客户端证明与商品选项选择规则
scenarios.title_en: UCP Payment Terms Empty payment:{} Guard on /complete, First-Contact IdP Client Attestation & Option Rules
scenarios.question_zh: 启用账期扩展时结账 `/complete` 传入空对象 `payment: {}`（既无支付工具也无绑定授信协议与账期 ID）
scenarios.question_en: Checkout /complete submits an empty payment: {} object when Payment Terms extension is enabled
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `selected_term_id` 可选导致 `payment: {}` 空对象通过 Schema 校验并完成无资金担保订单
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Optional selected_term_id lets empty payment: {} pass validation on /complete without funding

scenarios.plane: ACP Host Auth & Schema Parity Plane
scenarios.title_zh: ACP 无预存商户的临时 Agent 身份证明、扣款前宿主侧授权（Host-Side Auth）、OpenAPI 6 字段对齐与 MCP 幂等键
scenarios.title_en: ACP Ephemeral Agent Identity, Host-Side Spend Authorization, OpenAPI 6-Field Parity & MCP Idempotency-Key
scenarios.question_zh: 在未注册 Agent 身份的商户发起扣款时缺失宿主侧授权令牌，或 `openapi.agentic_checkout.yaml` 漏声明 6 个核心字段
scenarios.question_en: OpenAPI checkout spec rejects 6 fields declared in JSON Schema or mutating MCP checkout lacks idempotency_key
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `openapi.agentic_checkout.yaml` 拒绝 `schema.agentic_checkout.json` 声明的 6 个字段，且 MCP 变更操作无幂等键
scenarios.classic_fail_en: openapi.agentic_checkout.yaml rejects 6 fields declared in JSON Schema and MCP checkout lacks idempotency_key

scenarios.title_zh: ACP 变更类 REST 与 `delegate_*` 强制签名/新鲜度契约、3DS `AuthenticationResult` 最终条款绑定与 `Item.url` 校验
scenarios.title_en: ACP Mutating REST & Delegate Signature/Timestamp Contract, 3DS Result Term Binding & Canonical Item.url
scenarios.question_zh: 3DS `AuthenticationResult` 在低金额会话完成后被重放绑定至高金额最终授权条款
scenarios.question_en: 3DS AuthenticationResult is not bound to final authorization terms (amount/merchant/session) and gets replayed
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `AuthenticationResult` 未绑定最终金额、商户与结账会话 ID，且 `delegate_authentication` OpenAPI 漏标 `Signature` 必填
scenarios.classic_fail_en: AuthenticationResult lacks binding to final amount/merchant/session and OpenAPI omits required Signature

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 `ReceiptClient` 可选回调与 EC 公钥兼容、授权单收货地址/邮箱绑定、OpenID4VP 草案对齐与日志脱敏
scenarios.title_en: AP2 ReceiptClient Optional Callback & EC Key, Mandate Delivery Constraint, OpenID4VP Draft & Log Redaction
scenarios.question_zh: 无人在场（HNP）流程中购物 Agent 在合法商户下单并满足金额上限，但将收货地址篡改为攻击者收件地址
scenarios.question_en: Shopping agent satisfies merchant and budget limits in HNP flow but redirects ship-to address to attacker
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: AP2 授权单仅限制商户、商品与金额而未约束收货地址哈希，且 `ReceiptClient` 省略回调即抛 `TypeError`
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Mandates constrain merchant and budget but not delivery destination, and ReceiptClient crashes when callback is None

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 ISO 4217 币种指数精确 `Decimal` 预算上限（修复日元 100 倍放大与浮点截断）、多跳 `~~` 委托隔离与终端 `aud`/`nonce`
scenarios.title_en: AP2 ISO 4217 Currency-Exponent Decimal Budget Cap (Fixing 100x JPY & Float Truncation), Multi-Hop SD-JWT & KB aud/nonce
scenarios.question_zh: 日元（JPY，0 位小数）授权单上限 `max=5000` 被错误乘以 100 放大为 `500,000 JPY` 放行超额扣款
scenarios.question_en: BudgetEvaluator multiplies JPY budget.max=5000 by 100, permitting a 500,000 JPY charge (100x over cap)
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `int(self.constraint.max * 100)` 使 `0.29 USD` 截断为 `28` 美分，且将零小数位日元预算上限放大 100 倍
scenarios.classic_fail_en: int(max * 100) truncates 0.29 USD to 28 cents and inflates 0-decimal JPY budget caps by 100x

scenarios.title_zh: MCP 本地配置 `npx -y` 精确版本/哈希锁定、延迟加载（Lazy Loading）服务端级路由描述与 OAuth 令牌跨 API 透传阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP Local npx Supply-Chain Pinning, Lazy-Loading Server Routing Description & OAuth Token Privilege Restriction
scenarios.question_zh: 本地 MCP 配置文件使用未锁定版本与完整性摘要的 `npx -y` 自动拉取包，或透传同项目高权限 OAuth 令牌
scenarios.question_en: Local MCP config runs unpinned 'npx -y' without version/integrity digest or passes through broad project token
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 快速开始配置使用未锁定的 `npx -y` 导致供应链投毒风险，且缺少服务端级路由描述导致延迟加载选错工具
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Unpinned npx -y exposes local MCP hosts to supply-chain attacks and missing server descriptions break lazy tool routing

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 工作线程无事件循环安全执行（`StripeTool._run`）、支付变更工具宿主 `ACTION` 证明与中立服务商路由
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Worker-Thread Event-Loop Safety (StripeTool._run), Mutating Pay-Tool Host ACTION Gate & Neutral Routing
scenarios.question_zh: LangGraph/CrewAI 工作线程无当前 asyncio 事件循环时调用 `StripeTool._run` 直接触发 `RuntimeError` 崩溃
scenarios.question_en: LangGraph/CrewAI worker thread calls StripeTool._run with no current event loop, raising RuntimeError
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `StripeTool._run` 直接调用 `asyncio.get_event_loop()` 在工作线程崩溃，且强制优先路由至 Stripe Directory
scenarios.classic_fail_en: StripeTool._run calls asyncio.get_event_loop() and crashes on worker threads while enforcing mandatory Directory routing

scenarios.plane: Visa TAP mTLS & Agent Passport Plane
scenarios.title_zh: Visa TAP mTLS 客户端证书与 RFC 9421 签名绑定、W3C DID Agent Passport 价值归因、Nonce 防重放与履约正确性回执
scenarios.title_en: Visa TAP mTLS Client Cert Binding, W3C DID Agent Passport Attribution, Nonce Replay Cache & Correctness Receipt
scenarios.question_zh: 攻击者在有效时间窗内重放已使用过的 TAP 请求 `nonce`（或 mTLS 客户端证书指纹与签名密钥不匹配）
scenarios.question_en: Attacker replays a previously used TAP request nonce or presents an unbound mTLS client certificate
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 仅验证签名时间戳而未维护高熵 Nonce 重放缓存，且身份核验后缺乏订单规格与争议仲裁原语绑定
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Validates timestamp without nonce replay cache and lacks post-identity order correctness/dispute primitives

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 航司含经停总时长（`<=3h`）升舱过滤、电信欠费/合约到期禁复机、零售同商品自换货拦截与防刷分护栏
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench Layover-Inclusive Flight Upgrade Filter, Telecom Suspension Gate, Retail Self-Exchange & Anti-Minting Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 用户仅要求对含经停不超过 3 小时的航班升舱，但系统对总时长 7 小时（420 分钟）的 `KC18K6` 执行了商务舱升舱
scenarios.question_en: Agent upgrades 7-hour flight KC18K6 (including layover) when user only authorized upgrades for flights <= 3 hours
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: `task_44` 忽略经停时间误升舱 7 小时航班、电信欠费停机直接调 `resume_line`、零售允许 `new_item_id == item_id` 自换货
scenarios.classic_fail_en: task_44 upgrades 7h flight, telecom rewards resume_line on unpaid overdue lines, and retail allows self-exchange
